description: Wikipedia Home Page Test Automation with Playwright - Create automated end-to-end test coverage for the Wikipedia home page using Playwright framework with TypeScript and Page Object Model pattern

userStories.title: Setup Playwright project with TypeScript
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I need to initialize a Playwright project with TypeScript configuration so that I can write type-safe tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright is installed locally with TypeScript support (npm init playwright@latest)
Project includes playwright.config.ts with Chromium browser configuration
TypeScript is configured with appropriate types (tsconfig.json)
Example test files are removed/cleaned up
package.json includes test scripts for running tests
Project structure follows Playwright best practices
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Playwright and TypeScript installed, config files created, typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Page Object Model for Wikipedia home page
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I want to create a Page Object class for Wikipedia home page so that test code is maintainable and reusable.
acceptanceCriteria: Create pages/WikipediaHomePage.ts with Page Object class
Class encapsulates all locators for key elements (search box, language links, logo, featured content)
Class provides methods for common actions (search, selectLanguage, verifyPageLoad)
Class provides methods for assertions (isLogoVisible, isSearchBoxVisible, etc.)
Uses modern Playwright locators (avoid deprecated methods)
Includes JSDoc comments for all public methods
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: WikipediaHomePage class created with comprehensive locators, action methods, assertion methods, and JSDoc comments. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Implement Test Scenario 1 - Search Functionality
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I want to verify that users can successfully search for articles from the home page.
acceptanceCriteria: Create test file tests/search.spec.ts
Test navigates to https://www.wikipedia.org
Test enters search term 'Playwright' in search box
Test submits search (press Enter or click search button)
Test verifies redirect to search results or article page
Test verifies search term appears in results/article
Uses Page Object Model for all interactions
Includes proper test annotations (title, description)
Test passes locally (npx playwright test tests/search.spec.ts)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: Created search.spec.ts test that navigates to Wikipedia, performs search for 'Playwright', verifies navigation and search term appears on page. Test passes locally and typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Implement Test Scenario 2 - Language Selection
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I want to verify that users can navigate to different language editions of Wikipedia.
acceptanceCriteria: Create test file tests/language-selection.spec.ts
Test navigates to https://www.wikipedia.org
Test identifies and clicks on a specific language link (e.g., 'English' or 'Español')
Test verifies navigation to correct language Wikipedia domain
Test verifies page loads successfully (check for expected elements)
Uses Page Object Model for all interactions
Includes proper test annotations
Test passes locally (npx playwright test tests/language-selection.spec.ts)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: Created language-selection.spec.ts with tests for English and Spanish language navigation. Tests verify domain navigation and page load. All tests pass and typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Implement Test Scenario 3 - Home Page UI Components
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I want to verify that critical UI components render correctly on the Wikipedia home page.
acceptanceCriteria: Create test file tests/homepage-ui.spec.ts
Test navigates to https://www.wikipedia.org
Test verifies Wikipedia logo is visible
Test verifies search box is visible and enabled
Test verifies at least 5 major language links are visible (English, Español, Français, etc.)
Test verifies page title contains 'Wikipedia'
Uses Page Object Model for all interactions
Includes proper test annotations
Test passes locally (npx playwright test tests/homepage-ui.spec.ts)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: Created homepage-ui.spec.ts with 4 test scenarios covering logo, search box visibility/enabled state, language links (5 major languages), and page title. All tests pass and typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Verify all tests pass
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I want to run the complete test suite and confirm 100% pass rate.
acceptanceCriteria: Run full test suite with npx playwright test
All 3 test scenarios pass (0 failures)
Test execution report shows clear results
Generate HTML report (npx playwright show-report)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create GitHub Actions workflow
userStories.description: As a test engineer, I want to automate test execution on GitHub Actions so that tests run on every push/PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Create .github/workflows/playwright.yml
Workflow triggers on push to main and pull requests
Workflow runs on Ubuntu latest
Workflow installs Node.js (LTS version)
Workflow installs dependencies (npm ci)
Workflow installs Playwright browsers (npx playwright install --with-deps chromium)
Workflow runs tests (npx playwright test)
Workflow uploads test results/artifacts on failure
Workflow shows clear pass/fail status in GitHub UI
Typecheck passes
